You open your hands to the circle. Warmth leaves you in a green current, dividing where each companion needs it most.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Target / range / shape
Up to three visible willing creatures within 3 squares, including yourself, or creatures in range harmed by healing.
Type
Magic / Recovery

Pay 7 HP once and make a Reason healing roll. Divide the pool among the chosen recipients, assigning at least 1 HP to each.

Weak
Share 12 HP, allocating up to 8 HP per recipient.
Standard
Share 20 HP, allocating up to 12 HP per recipient.
Strong
Share 28 HP, allocating up to 16 HP per recipient; each beneficial recipient may reduce temporary Poisoned by 1.
